tagline.en: Alibaba PAI's EasyAnimate — a DiT-based video family for text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video.
tagline.zh: 阿里云 PAI 的 EasyAnimate——基于 DiT 的视频家族，支持文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频。

en: EasyAnimate is a video generation family from Alibaba PAI. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video, so you can start from a prompt, animate a still image, or transform an existing clip.

The family spans several releases and sizes, including 12B and 7B checkpoints in the V5 and V5.1 generations. The V5.1 7B and 12B weights are Apache-2.0, while some earlier checkpoints carry other terms. Image-to-video uses the InP checkpoint variants, and the plain V5.1 checkpoint handles text-to-video.
In WorldFoundry, EasyAnimate's image-to-video route runs through the shared pipeline with the official V5.1 InP checkpoint and Flow scheduler — give it a source image and a prompt to produce a clip.
zh: EasyAnimate 是阿里云 PAI 推出的视频生成家族。它覆盖文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频，可以从提示词起步、让静态图片动起来，或改造一段已有片段。
该家族跨越多个版本与规模，包括 V5 与 V5.1 代的 12B 与 7B checkpoint。其中 V5.1 的 7B 与 12B 权重为 Apache-2.0，部分较早的 checkpoint 采用其他许可条款。图生视频使用 InP checkpoint 变体，而普通 V5.1 checkpoint 负责文生视频。
在 WorldFoundry 中，EasyAnimate 的图生视频路径通过统一 pipeline 运行，采用官方 V5.1 InP checkpoint 与 Flow 调度器——给它一张源图和提示词即可生成片段。

whenToUse.en: A flexible choice when you need multiple video modes — text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video — in one family, with openly-licensed V5.1 checkpoints available.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在同一家族里使用多种视频模式——文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频——且希望有开放许可的 V5.1 checkpoint 时，它很灵活。

notFor.en: Note that licensing varies by checkpoint: V5.1 7B/12B are Apache-2.0, but some earlier releases use other terms — check the specific checkpoint before redistribution. Weights are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 注意各 checkpoint 许可不同：V5.1 7B/12B 为 Apache-2.0，但部分较早版本采用其他条款——再分发前请核对具体 checkpoint。权重需单独下载。

en: Text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video in one family
12B and 7B checkpoints across V5 and V5.1 generations
Image-to-video uses the official InP checkpoints with a Flow scheduler
zh: 文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频同属一个家族
V5 与 V5.1 代提供 12B 与 7B checkpoint
V5.1 7B 与 12B 采用 Apache-2.0 许可
图生视频使用官方 InP checkpoint 与 Flow 调度器
